calls.thesis: Great business, beautiful growth (29% GMV, 32% revenue, FCF $2.7bn TTM) but 83x FCF is too high a price; DCF of 30% FCF growth at 50x FCF yields only a 9% CAGR, and the multiple will contract as growth decelerates.
calls.price_at_call: 83x free cash flow; no share price stated; down 21% from recent highs

calls.thesis: One of the 'winners to buy': Muse lets users find Shopify merchant products and check out via Shop Pay; if Muse becomes the new front door for shopping, Shopify is the rails underneath. Jumped double digits last week.
